datasheet_identity.title: SM4001PL THRU SM4007PL SURFACE MOUNT GENERAL PURPOSE SILICON RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The SM4007PL column was transcribed from the shared p. 1 ratings table: VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, IFSM = 25 A, VF max = 1.1 V at 1.0 A, IR max = 10 uA at TA = 25 degC, and CJ typical = 4 pF at 1 MHz and 4 V reverse bias.
The forward curve points are digitized readings from the TJ = 25 degC trace in p. 2 Fig. 3; no interpolation was added.
The reverse-current plot is labeled 1N4007W rather than SM4007PL, so it was not used as a structured curve for this part.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time value. Operating junction and storage temperature ranges are -55 to +150 degC.
